title: Authentic production modular candidate workloads
objective: Add deterministic warm-profile sources and uninstrumented phase/oracle runners for real public prime-field integral, number-field local-polygon, hyperelliptic local-reduction, and cubic factor-base workloads, preserving exact result evidence and making no optimization-selection claim.

oracles: Exact public GF(65537) antiderivative derivative replay and degree
Frozen local-polygon fixture outcomes plus CPython same-source differential
Independent CPython point counts for the normalization curve y^2=x^3+1
Exact cubic factor-base replay against generic modular factorization and a pinned packed-payload digest

handoff.summary: Four deterministic CPython-parseable warm-profile entries now cover the authentic public GF(65537) degree-69999 integral, frozen plus repeated number-field local polygons, public hyperelliptic local reduction at p=5003/10009/20011, and the x^3-1009 cubic factor-base phase. One uninstrumented adapter preserves raw setup, production, exact-oracle, same-source CPython, and cost-gate samples and deliberately makes no route-selection claim. Focused tests, CPython differential/oracles, formatting, lane checks, and cross-root authentic Sage.js execution passed.
risks: The lane worktree has no prepared FLINT addon, so its current-build-gated four-workload test remains skipped; the same source entries all passed against an explicitly selected current integration runtime, which is development evidence rather than a promotion receipt.

Architecture verification reaches the optimizer dashboard check and reports the generated dashboard stale because these new benchmark sources enter its census; only integration may regenerate that shared artifact.
The catalog, static source inventory, and warm-profiler command integration are intentionally not edited by this lane and remain integration-owned.
next_steps: Register the four workloads and the runner phase IDs in the integration-owned catalog and source inventory.
Regenerate the optimizer opportunity dashboard after integration.
Run the four-workload specialized test and warm profiler from the integrated current build with platform-native dependencies prepared.
